title: Article 314 — Provision for protection of existing officers of certain services (Omitted)

content.overview: Article 314 provided protection for existing officers of certain services (including covenanting officers from former Indian States). It was omitted by constitutional amendment in the course of rationalising transitional service protections after reorganisation. It is not living law; service conditions are governed by Part XIV and ordinary service law.
content.glance: Art 314 omitted. Transitional protection of existing officers; not living law. See Part XIV.
content.study:
Article 314 was a transitional guarantee for officers who continued from pre-Constitution or Part B arrangements.

Status: Omitted; not part of the living text.

Living frame: Recruitment and conditions of service are under Articles 309–311 and applicable rules; public service commissions under Chapter II of Part XIV.

Examination rule: Do not cite Article 314 as a current service-protection clause.

sections.heading: Constitutional status
sections.body: Article 314 stands omitted. Transitional service protections connected with integration of services were wound up; living service law is in Part XIV.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What is the status of Article 314?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 314 has been omitted and is not living law. Current service conditions are governed by Part XIV (Articles 309–311 and related provisions) and ordinary service rules.

examTips: Redirect service-protection questions to Art 311 and Part XIV.
content.migrationNote: Remediated 2026-10-09: omitted status and Part XIV redirect. Case-law gate open.

notes: Omitted status recorded; living frame Part XIV. No invented holdings.

keyTakeaways: Art 314 omitted; use Part XIV for service conditions.

examples.body: Facts that satisfy the elements stated in the provision produce the consequence described in the text.

hypotheticals.question: Do the facts engage art-314?
hypotheticals.analysis: Compare the facts with the statutory or constitutional elements stated in the text.

distinctions.title: Scope of art-314
distinctions.body: Applies only within the elements and consequences stated in the constitutional text.

misconceptions.myth: art-314 creates unlimited or extra-textual rights.
misconceptions.correction: It operates only as stated in the constitutional provision.
